build_task_template: build a PHYRE physics task template that creates a ball dropping onto a bottom wall with static obstacles
generate_line_of_points: generate a randomized line of coordinate points using a base angle and step size for obstacle placement
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene at a specified center position and scale
add_static_obstacles: add static ball obstacles arranged in angled rows across the PHYRE scene
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define a TOUCHING spatial relationship between the ball and bottom wall
